faq_heading: New construction in West End, Vancouver: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in West End, Vancouver sold for?
faq.a: 314 condos sold in West End, Vancouver at a median of $770,000, with the middle half between $555,900 and $1,183,750.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in West End, Vancouver?
faq.a: Condos in West End, Vancouver took 28 days at a median to sell.

faq.q: Which homes in West End, Vancouver are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in West End, Vancouver, condos had the newest median build year, 1989.

blocks.text: The search above lists active MLS® listings in West End, Vancouver where the board's age field reads 0 or less: homes finished this year, and homes listed ahead of completion. Houses, townhomes and condos are in; land and income properties are not. Over November 2025 to October 2026, the busiest home type in West End, Vancouver was condos: 314 sales at a median of $770,000, and 1 type had 5 or more sales.

How West End compares with the rest of Vancouver West

items.t: Condos in West End have the 17th highest median of 21 Vancouver West sub-areas, $770,000. Marpole is lowest at $613,500 and Coal Harbour highest at $1,228,000. Fairview ($756,000) sits just below and False Creek ($771,500) sits just above.
